title: Camp before the Ridge
story: The group left the road at dawn and climbed toward a high ridge. Malik carried the tent, and Sofia carried the food bag. Clouds sat on the ridge, so they stopped early in a flat hollow. They put the tent up between two rocks that blocked the wind. Sofia boiled water for soup and shared bread. A ranger had told them not to cross the ridge in fog. Malik wanted to push on, but the cloud was too thick. They agreed to wait until morning. During the night the wind pulled at the tent, yet the ropes held. At sunrise the ridge was clear. They started the last climb.
